name: Tabuse Riko
source:
One of regular customers at "Blue Comet". A manga lover who is actually an assistant of a manga artist. Wears jersey a lot when she's at home.

She has a dedicated editor and work on creating their own manga while assisting in production. She may seem cool and reserved, but is passionate about manga and hold deep emotions for it.

She spends her days pursuing their dreams and ideals with a pen in hand. She dresses appropriately when going out but wear casual clothes like tracksuits at home.
